rationale: C09 plausibly supplied substantial language and administrative machinery for the child. It assigns the Secretary of the Interior responsibility for priorities and allocations concerning petroleum, gas, solid fuels, and electric power; defines those resources in language reproduced nearly verbatim by the child; and provides related mechanisms for assessing requirements, expanding supply, developing strategic minerals, financing production, stockpiling, coordination, and redelegation. C02 is also a strong framework source because it establishes uniform Emergency Preparedness Orders for plans covering all national emergencies and contains the child's reservation against implementing plans without further authority. C25 contains closely related definitions and resource-management machinery, but C09 is the closer and more comprehensive match.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Secretary of the Interior ... shall prepare national emergency plans and develop preparedness programs covering (1) electric power; (2) petroleum and gas; (3) solid fuels; and (4) minerals.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Secretary of the Interior with respect to petroleum, gas, solid fuels and electric power.
shared_material.explanation: C09 supplies the same distinctive grouping of resources assigned to the same cabinet officer.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The term "electric power" means all forms of electric power and energy, including the generation, transmission, distribution, and utilization thereof.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The term "electric power" shall mean all forms of electric power and energy, including the generation, transmission, distribution, and utilization thereof.
shared_material.explanation: This definition is reproduced essentially verbatim.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The term "petroleum" means crude oil and synthetic liquid fuel, their products, and associated hydrocarbons, including pipelines for their movement ... The term "gas" means natural gas ... and manufactured gas, including pipelines for the movement....
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The term "petroleum" shall mean crude oil and synthetic liquid fuel, their products, and associated hydrocarbons, including pipelines for the movement thereof. The term "gas" shall mean natural gas and manufactured gas, including pipelines for the movement thereof.
shared_material.explanation: The child closely copies both paired definitions while adding storage facilities and helium.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Develop systems for the emergency application of priorities and allocations to the production and distribution of assigned resources.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The functions conferred upon the President by Title I ... are hereby delegated ... [to] the Secretary of the Interior with respect to petroleum, gas, solid fuels and electric power.
shared_material.explanation: The child's operative priorities-and-allocations responsibility adapts C09's resource-specific delegation into emergency-planning form.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Develop programs and encourage the exploration, development and mining of strategic and critical minerals for emergency purposes.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Director ... is hereby authorized and directed to encourage the exploration, development, and mining of critical and strategic minerals and metals....
shared_material.explanation: The same specialized mineral-development function is carried forward with the responsible officer and emergency purpose adapted.
